layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/tree/main/ca/cibc (2022: no header, Y-m-d, date, description, debit, credit, then an ignored column, the card number on a credit card download)
notes: No header row. Date YYYY-MM-DD, description, money out, money in (unsigned, one of the two empty); a credit card download adds a fifth column with the masked card number. No balance. Quoted descriptions, newest first, LF and the file name cibc.csv are assumed from memory of the export, not from a source; the description wording follows CIBC's statement style ("Point of Sale - Interac RETAIL PURCHASE ...").
